name: The Legends of Rock and Pop
description: Seventy years of the music that filled stadiums and radios: from Elvis and Chuck Berry to Beyoncé, the voices, bands and albums that shaped popular music.

checkpoints.name: Rock and roll
checkpoints.note: Chuck Berry, Little Richard and Elvis blend blues, country and gospel into a sound for teenagers, while Ray Charles and Johnny Cash bring their own roots to the radio.

checkpoints.name: The album age
checkpoints.note: The Beatles, Stones and Dylan turn singles into albums and albums into statements, while Hendrix, Led Zeppelin, Pink Floyd, Marley and Bowie push sound and stagecraft.

checkpoints.name: The video era
checkpoints.note: MTV makes the image as important as the song. Michael Jackson's Thriller, Madonna and Prince rule the charts, and Queen's Live Aid set draws the world's eyes.

checkpoints.name: Streaming stars
checkpoints.note: Beyoncé and Taylor Swift build huge careers in the download and streaming age, drawing on the soul, country and rock traditions the earlier stars had made.
